1455→ 1456→// You can also check multiple resource permissions at the same time 1457→const canCreateProjectAndCreateSale = 1458→ authClient.organization.checkRolePermission({ 1459→ permissions: { 1460→ organization: ["delete"], 1461→ member: ["delete"], 1462→ }, 1463→ role: "admin", 1464→ }); 1465→``` 1466→ 1467→ 1468→ This will not include any dynamic roles as everything is ran synchronously on the client side. 1469→ Please use the [hasPermission](#access-control-usage) APIs to include checks for any dynamic roles & permissions. 1470→ 1471→ 1472→--- 1473→ 1474→## Dynamic Access Control 1475→ 1476→Dynamic access control allows you to create roles at runtime for organizations. This is achieved by storing the 1477→created roles and permissions associated with an organization in a database table. 1478→ 1479→### Enabling Dynamic Access Control 1480→ 1481→To enable dynamic access control, pass the `dynamicAccessControl` configuration option with `enabled` set to `true` to both server and client plugins. 1482→ 1483→Ensure you have pre-defined an `ac` instance on the server auth plugin. 1484→This is important as this is how we can infer the permissions that are available for use. 1485→ 1486→```ts title="auth.ts" 1487→import { betterAuth } from "better-auth"; 1488→import { organization } from "better-auth/plugins"; 1489→import { ac } from "@/auth/permissions"; 1490→ 1491→export const auth = betterAuth({ 1492→ plugins: [ 1493→ organization({ // [!code highlight] 1494→ ac, // Must be defined in order for dynamic access control to work // [!code highlight] 1495→ dynamicAccessControl: { // [!code highlight] 1496→ enabled: true, // [!code highlight] 1497→ }, // [!code highlight] 1498→ }) // [!code highlight] 1499→ ] 1500→}) 1501→``` 1502→ 1503→```ts title="auth-client.ts" 1504→import { createAuthClient } from "better-auth/client"; 1505→import { organizationClient } from "better-auth/client/plugins"; 1506→ 1507→export const authClient = createAuthClient({ 1508→ plugins: [ 1509→ organizationClient({ // [!code highlight] 1510→ dynamicAccessControl: { // [!code highlight] 1511→ enabled: true, // [!code highlight] 1512→ }, // [!code highlight] 1513→ }) // [!code highlight] 1514→ ] 1515→}) 1516→``` 1517→ 1518→ 1519→ This will require you to run migrations to add the new `organizationRole` table to the database. 1520→ 1521→ 1522→ 1523→ 1524→ The `authClient.organization.checkRolePermission` function will not include any dynamic roles as everything is ran synchronously on the client side. 1525→ Please use the [hasPermission](#access-control-usage) APIs to include checks for any dynamic roles. 1526→ 1527→ 1528→### Creating a role 1529→ 1530→To create a new role for an organization at runtime, you can use the `createRole` function. 1531→ 1532→Only users with roles which contain the `ac` resource with the `create` permission can create a new role. 1533→By default, only the `admin` and `owner` roles have this permission. You also cannot add permissions that your 1534→current role in that organization can't already access. 1535→ 1536→ 1542→```ts 1543→// To use custom resources or permissions, 1544→// make sure they are defined in the `ac` instance of your organization config. 1545→const permission = { 1546→ project: ["create", "update", "delete"] 1547→} 1548→ 1549→type createOrgRole = { 1550→ /** 1551→ * A unique name of the role to create. 1552→ */ 1553→ role: string = "my-unique-role" 1554→ /** 1555→ * The permissions to assign to the role. 1556→ */ 1557→ permission?: Record = permission, 1558→ /** 1559→ * The organization ID which the role will be created in. Defaults to the active organization. 1560→ */ 1561→ organizationId?: string = "organization-id" 1562→} 1563→``` 1564→ 1565→ 1566→Now you can freely call [`updateMemberRole`](#update-member-role) to update the role of a member with your newly created role! 1567→ 1568→### Deleting a role 1569→ 1570→To delete a role, you can use the `deleteRole` function, then provide either a `roleName` or `roleId` parameter along 1571→with the `organizationId` parameter. 1572→ 1573→ 1579→```ts 1580→type deleteOrgRole = { 1581→ /** 1582→ * The name of the role to delete.   role: string (required)
  permission: string (required, JSON stored)
  createdAt: Date (required)
  updatedAt: Date | null (optional)

```

---

### 5. Client-Side Organization Methods

**Client Plugin** (`/Users/orksys/Projects/docs-worktrees/better-auth/packages/better-auth/src/plugins/organization/client.ts`):

```typescript
import { createAuthClient } from "better-auth/client"
import { organizationClient } from "better-auth/client/plugins"

export const authClient = createAuthClient({
  plugins: [
    organizationClient({
      ac: accessControl, // optional
      roles: { owner, admin, member }, // optional custom roles
      teams: { enabled: true }, // optional
      schema: { ... }, // optional additional fields
      dynamicAccessControl: { enabled: true }, // optional
    }),
  ],
})
```

```typescript

authClient.organization.create({ name, slug, logo?, metadata? })
authClient.organization.update({ data: { name?, slug?, logo?, metadata? }, organizationId? })
authClient.organization.delete({ organizationId })
authClient.organization.setActive({ organizationId | organizationSlug })
authClient.organization.getFullOrganization({ organizationId?, organizationSlug?, membersLimit? })
authClient.organization.list()
authClient.organization.checkSlug({ slug })

// Member methods

authClient.organization.updateMemberRole({ role, memberId, organizationId? })
authClient.organization.leave({ organizationId })
authClient.organization.listMembers({ organizationId?, limit?, offset?, sortBy?, ... })
authClient.organization.getActiveMember()
authClient.organization.getActiveMemberRole({ userId?, organizationId?, organizationSlug? })

// Invitation methods

authClient.organization.rejectInvitation({ invitationId })

authClient.organization.getInvitation({ id })

1. **Adapter Pattern**: The `getOrgAdapter()` function wraps the base database adapter with organization-specific methods for all CRUD operations.

2. **Permission Checking**: Uses `hasPermission()` function with role-based access control supporting both static and dynamic permissions.

3. **Session Integration**: Active organization is stored in the session table, allowing automatic context switching.

4. **Hook System**: Comprehensive lifecycle hooks for all operations (before/after) with ability to modify data or throw errors to abort operations.

    31→	"organization",

    55→		organizationId: text("organization_id")
    56→			.notNull()
    57→			.references(() => organization.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),

    60→		updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at")

    63→			.notNull(),

# Organization Management & Member Invitations

## Context

Implement organization management UI to allow users to manage team members and send invitations using the Better Auth organizations plugin. The backend is already configured with roles (owner, admin, member) and permissions. This adds the frontend UI layer.

---

## File Structure

```
apps/web/src/
├── app/(app)/
│   ├── settings/
│   │   └── organization/
│   │       └── page.tsx                    # Organization settings page
│   └── invitations/
│       └── [invitationId]/
│           └── page.tsx                    # Invitation accept/reject page
│
└── components/organization/
    ├── index.ts
    ├── types.ts
    ├── member-list.tsx                     # Member table with actions
    ├── member-actions-menu.tsx             # Role change, remove member
    ├── invitation-list.tsx                 # Pending invitations
    ├── invite-member-dialog.tsx            # Responsive dialog/sheet
    ├── role-badge.tsx                      # Badge for owner/admin/member
    └── hooks/
        ├── index.ts
        ├── use-organization-members.ts
        ├── use-invitations.ts
        └── use-member-actions.ts
```

---

## Implementation Steps

### Step 1: Types & Hooks

**`components/organization/types.ts`**
```typescript
export type MemberRole = "owner" | "admin" | "member";
export type InvitationStatus = "pending" | "accepted" | "rejected" | "canceled";

export interface Member {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  user: { id: string; name: string; email: string; image?: string };
  role: MemberRole;
  createdAt: Date;
}

export interface Invitation {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  role: MemberRole;
  status: InvitationStatus;
  expiresAt: Date;
  createdAt: Date;
}
```

**`components/organization/hooks/use-organization-members.ts`**
- Query for `authClient.organization.listMembers()`
- Returns `{ members, isLoading, refetch }`

**`components/organization/hooks/use-member-actions.ts`**
- Mutations for `removeMember`, `updateMemberRole`
- Invalidates queries on success, shows toast notifications

**`components/organization/hooks/use-invitations.ts`**
- Query for `authClient.organization.listInvitations()`
- Mutations for `inviteMember`, `cancelInvitation`

### Step 2: Role Badge Component

**`components/organization/role-badge.tsx`**
- Owner: primary variant
- Admin: secondary variant
- Member: outline variant

### Step 3: Member List Component

**`components/organization/member-list.tsx`**
- Table layout with columns: Avatar, Name, Email, Role, Joined, Actions
- Responsive: Table on desktop, Card list on mobile
- Member actions dropdown for admins/owners

**`components/organization/member-actions-menu.tsx`**
- Change Role submenu (member <-> admin, owner only for admin assignment)
- Remove member (confirmation dialog)
- Disabled for self and last owner

### Step 4: Invitation List Component

**`components/organization/invitation-list.tsx`**
- Shows pending invitations with email, role, expires date
- Cancel button for pending invitations
- Empty state when no invitations

### Step 5: Invite Member Dialog

**`components/organization/invite-member-dialog.tsx`**
- Responsive: Dialog on desktop, Sheet on mobile (use `useIsMobile`)
- Form with email input and role select
- Uses `@tanstack/react-form` + Zod (follow `create-organization-form.tsx` pattern)
- Success/error toasts with `sonner`

### Step 6: Settings Page

**`app/(app)/settings/organization/page.tsx`**
- Tabs: Members | Invitations
- Members tab: MemberList + InviteMemberDialog
- Invitations tab: InvitationList
- Page header with organization name

### Step 7: Invitation Acceptance Page

**`app/(app)/invitations/[invitationId]/page.tsx`**
- Fetch invitation via `authClient.organization.getInvitation()`
- Show organization name, role, inviter info
- Accept/Reject buttons
- Handle: not authenticated (redirect to sign in), expired, already accepted
- On accept: call `acceptInvitation`, set active org, redirect to dashboard

### Step 8: Navigation Updates

- Add "Settings" link to user menu (`components/user-menu.tsx`)
- Add to app sidebar if applicable

---

## Key Patterns to Follow

### Form Pattern (from create-organization-form.tsx)
```typescript
const form = useForm({
  defaultValues: { email: "", role: "member" },
  onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
    const result = await authClient.organization.inviteMember({
      email: value.email,
      role: value.role,
    });
    if (result.error) {
      toast.error(result.error.message);
      return;
    }
    toast.success("Invitation sent");
    onSuccess?.();
  },
  validators: {
    onSubmit: z.object({
      email: z.string().email(),
      role: z.enum(["member", "admin"]),
    }),
  },
});
```

### Responsive Dialog/Sheet Pattern
```typescript
function InviteMemberDialog() {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <SheetTrigger asChild><Button>Invite</Button></SheetTrigger>
        <SheetContent><InviteForm onSuccess={() => setOpen(false)} /></SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild><Button>Invite</Button></DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent><InviteForm onSuccess={() => setOpen(false)} /></DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

---

## API Methods (No new routes needed)

All operations use existing Better Auth client methods:

| Operation | Method |
|-----------|--------|
| List members | `authClient.organization.listMembers()` |
| Invite member | `authClient.organization.inviteMember({ email, role })` |
| Remove member | `authClient.organization.removeMember({ memberIdOrEmail })` |
| Update role | `authClient.organization.updateMemberRole({ memberId, role })` |
| List invitations | `authClient.organization.listInvitations()` |
| Cancel invitation | `authClient.organization.cancelInvitation({ invitationId })` |
| Get invitation | `authClient.organization.getInvitation({ id })` |
| Accept invitation | `authClient.organization.acceptInvitation({ invitationId })` |
| Reject invitation | `authClient.organization.rejectInvitation({ invitationId })` |

---

## Permission Rules

From `packages/auth/src/permissions.ts`:

- **Owner**: Full access, can assign admin role, manage billing
- **Admin**: Can invite/remove members, create/cancel invitations
- **Member**: Can view organization, cannot manage members

UI should hide action buttons for users without permission.

---

## Verification

1. Create organization, invite member via email
2. Accept invitation as new user
3. Verify member appears in list with correct role
4. Test role change (admin can change member role)
5. Test remove member (admin can remove members)
6. Test cancel invitation
7. Test responsive layouts (mobile/desktop)
8. Verify permission restrictions (member cannot see invite/manage buttons)
